lines.en: label dormwarssix12:
$ day = 7
$ totaldays += 1
show sunday
scene endofwarsix1
: Good morning, Kumon-mi! And good morning to the roughly two-thirds of you who managed to make it here to our sixth annual Dorm Wars closing ceremony!
lines.zh: : 早上好，Kumon-mi！也向在座大约三分之二、成功赶来参加我们第六届宿舍战争闭幕式的人问好！

lines.en: : Also known as the least important part of the Dorm Wars in most cases since {i}winning{/i} hasn’t really come with any sort of tangible perk for a while now.
lines.zh: : 在大多数情况下，这也算是宿舍战争里最不重要的环节，毕竟{i}赢{/i}这件事已经有好一阵子没带来什么实打实的好处了。

lines.en: : We’ve got the most tangible perk of all this time, though! A real, live man-slave for an entire night during the next beach trip!
lines.zh: : 不过这次我们拿到了史上最实在的好处！下次海边旅行时，一个活生生的男人奴隶，整整一晚！

lines.en: : Kind of like the prize from the first Dorm Wars. Just more intense now that everyone is openly in love with Sensei and not still figuring themselves out.
lines.zh: : 有点像第一届宿舍战争的奖品。只是现在大家都公开爱着 Sensei，不再还在摸索自我，所以劲头更足了。

lines.en: : Just try not to be {i}too{/i} intense as I’ve already been in contact with the inn management staff and asked them to pay a little more attention to what’s going on in your rooms.
lines.zh: : 只是别{i}太{/i}过火——我已经跟旅馆的管理人员打过招呼，请他们多留意一下你们房间里发生的事。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix2
: Did you really? You didn’t, right? Please tell me you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 你真的干了？你没有吧？求你告诉我你没有。

lines.en: : Would there be a problem if I did, Uta?
lines.zh: : 如果我真干了，会有什么问题吗，Uta？

lines.en: : Not with me. I’m a coward. A bunch of other girls would really hate it, though, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 对我倒没问题。我是个胆小鬼。不过我敢肯定，其他好多女生会很讨厌这事。

lines.en: : Then I’m gonna go ahead and just not answer your question at all. That way, even if I’m a liar, you’ll be forced to wallow in uncertainty at the possibility that I actually did something.
lines.zh: : 那我就干脆完全不回答你的问题。这样一来，就算我在撒谎，你们也只能泡在不确定里，猜想我是不是真的做了什么。

lines.en: : Not knowing what’s going on is somehow even worse, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，不知道发生了什么反而更难受。

lines.en: : You can say that again, Uta.
lines.zh: : 说得太对了，Uta。

lines.en: : Not knowing what’s going on is somehow even worse, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，不知道发生了什么反而更难受。

lines.en: : I ain’t playin’ this game with you.
lines.zh: : 我可不陪你玩这个游戏。

lines.en: : Miss Imai — the results, if you would. I know a few of us still have places to be today. And Ami likely needs to get a head start on whatever fortress she’s going to build to prevent us from enslaving Sensei.
lines.zh: : Imai 老师——麻烦公布结果吧。我知道我们当中有些人今天还有别的地方要去。而且 Ami 大概得赶紧回去开工，建那座用来防止我们把 Sensei 变成奴隶的堡垒。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix3
: Just hide him in the maid cafe. He ain’t leaving that place unless you drag him out of there. And trust me when I say that I’ve had to.
lines.zh: : 把他藏在女仆咖啡厅就行了。除非你把他从那儿拖出来，他不会走的。我说我干过这事，你尽管信我。

lines.en: : It’s been another eventful year, gang! Perhaps the Dorm Warsiest Dorm Wars yet! Makoto got hit by a cone, Chika singlehandedly caused elephants to go extinct, and we all found out that Tsuneyo can act!
lines.zh: : 又是多事的一年，各位！也许是史上最有宿舍战争味的宿舍战争！Makoto 被锥形桶砸中，Chika 凭一己之力让大象灭绝，我们还都发现了 Tsuneyo 会演戏！

lines.en: : And, somehow or another, nobody seemed to get hurt this time! Except for Uta when she apparently exploded all over an idol.
lines.zh: : 而且不知怎么的，这次好像没人受伤！除了 Uta——她显然在一个偶像面前炸开了花。

lines.en: : Correction— I exploded in the {i}presence{/i} of an idol. Which is to be expected of a girl in a school that does not receive sexual education classes. I have not yet learned how to control myself, Miss Imai.
lines.zh: : 更正一下——我是在一个偶像的{i}面前{/i}炸开的。这对一所不开性教育课的学校里的女生来说也是意料之中。我还没学会怎么控制自己呢，Imai 老师。

lines.en: : I feel like sexual education would do close to nothing for any of us, but I do agree that its omission from our curriculum in particular is quite odd.
lines.zh: : 我觉得性教育对我们任何人大概都起不了什么作用，不过我同意，把它排除在我们的课程之外确实挺奇怪的。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix4
: Is there even anything {i}left{/i} to teach you, Makoto? Or do you somehow know more on this topic than even I do?
lines.zh: : Makoto，还有什么{i}剩下{/i}的能教你吗？还是说在这个话题上你懂得比我还多？

lines.en: : Uh-oh. Imani caught the Noriko eyes. I think the Niki thing is getting to her.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。Imani 染上了 Noriko 的眼神。我觉得 Niki 那件事让她有点上头了。

lines.en: : I am totally fine and everything is good.
lines.zh: : 我完全没事，一切都很好。

lines.en: : You don’t look good.
lines.zh: : 你看起来可不怎么好。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix5
if dormwarssixfloor1points > dormwarssixfloor2points:
: The winner of this year’s Dorm Wars is the first floor with a score of [dormwarssixfloor1points] to [dormwarssixfloor2points]!
lines.zh: : 今年宿舍战争的获胜者是——一楼！比分 [dormwarssixfloor1points] 比 [dormwarssixfloor2points]！

lines.en: : I now open the floor to Makoto so that she can brag about it.
lines.zh: : 现在我把话筒交给 Makoto，让她好好吹一吹。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix6
: Oh, did we win? I wasn’t keeping track of the score of anything. How fun.
lines.zh: : 哦，我们赢了？我什么比分都没在记。真有意思。

lines.en: : You sure about that, Makoto? I heard you practicing your victory speech in the bathroom at Sana’s bar last night and it didn’t sound anything like this.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗，Makoto？我昨晚在 Sana 的酒吧听见你在洗手间里练获奖感言，听起来可完全不是这样。

lines.en: : Don’t eavesdrop in bathrooms, Uta. People say a lot of crazy stuff in them when things are going down, you know?
lines.zh: : 别在洗手间偷听，Uta。事情进行到那一步的时候，人在里面会说很多疯话的，你懂吧？

lines.en: scene endofwarsix7
: No. What do they say?
lines.zh: : 不懂。她们都说什么？

lines.en: : Girls of the first floor-
lines.zh: : 一楼的姑娘们——

lines.en: : What do they say, Imani? Give me an example.
lines.zh: : 她们都说什么，Imani？举个例子。

lines.en: : I will head home momentarily to begin drafting out how to most fairly split up our time with Sensei at the beach this summer.
lines.zh: : 我稍后就回家，开始起草今年夏天在海边要怎么最公平地分配我们和 Sensei 相处的时间。

lines.en: : Until then, I welcome you to all begin coming up with ideas for embarrassing things that we can make him do.
lines.zh: : 在那之前，欢迎大家开始集思广益，想出些能让他做的丢人事情。

lines.en: : Without touching.
lines.zh: : 不许动手动脚。

lines.en: : Not all touching is bad.
lines.zh: : 又不是所有动手动脚都是坏事。

lines.en: : Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto。

lines.en: : Fine. {i}Without touching.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好吧。{i}不许动手动脚。{/i}

lines.en: : Tell me what they say, Imani. I’m not leaving you alone until you do.
lines.zh: : 告诉我她们说什么，Imani。你不说我就不放过你。

lines.en: $ dormwarssixfloor1win = True
if dormwarssixfloor2points > dormwarssixfloor1points:
: The winner of this year’s Dorm Wars is the second floor with a score of [dormwarssixfloor2points] to [dormwarssixfloor1points]!
lines.zh: : 今年宿舍战争的获胜者是——二楼！比分 [dormwarssixfloor2points] 比 [dormwarssixfloor1points]！

lines.en: scene endofwarsix8
: That’s right! And as the team captain, it is only fair that the reward goes entirely to me and that the rest of you all bunk with the first floor girls while Sensei and I share a hot night of-
lines.zh: : 没错！而且作为队长，奖品全归我一个人是天经地义的；你们其余人跟一楼的姑娘们挤一屋，而我和 Sensei 共享一个火热的夜晚——

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}咳咳。{/i}

lines.en: : Platonic and fully clothed decompression in the communal sauna!
lines.zh: : 在公共桑拿房里柏拉图式、穿戴整齐地放松一下！

lines.en: : You can get a little spicier than that. I’m a teacher, not a nun.
lines.zh: : 你可以再火辣一点。我是老师，又不是修女。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix9
: Well, how spicy can I get exactly? You’ve been weird lately and I don’t really understand what you are and aren’t okay with.
lines.zh: : 那我到底能有多火辣？你最近怪怪的，我真搞不懂你能接受什么、不能接受什么。

lines.en: : What a coincidence. Neither do I.
lines.zh: : 真巧。我也搞不懂。

lines.en: : {i}Zero{/i} spicy! Which is precisely the amount of spice Sensei would encounter if my team had tried harder and actually won since {i}we{/i} actually have dignity!
lines.zh: {i}一点都{/i}不火辣！如果我的队伍再努力一点、真的赢了的话，Sensei 会遇到的火辣程度正好就是这个数——因为{i}我们{/i}是有尊严的！

lines.en: scene endofwarsix10
: If you guys have so much dignity, why did Io find one of you digging for clams in the bathroom at the beach a while back?
lines.zh: : 如果你们这么有尊严，那前阵子在海边，Io 怎么会撞见你们当中有人在洗手间里挖蛤蜊？

lines.en: : Doing {i}what{/i} now?
lines.zh: : 你说在干{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Polishing the pearl. Flicking the bean. Buffing the muffin. Petting the poodle. Rubbing the-
lines.zh: : 擦珍珠。弹豆子。擦松饼。摸贵宾犬。搓——

lines.en: : Girl, how many phrases for that do you know?
lines.zh: : 丫头，这事你到底知道多少种说法？

lines.en: : That...never happened! You’re just lying to make the second floor look more refined and mature than we are!
lines.zh: : 那……那根本没发生过！你就是在撒谎，好显得二楼比我们高雅成熟！

lines.en: : Speaking of being refined and mature, I heard you’re having a sale on rotors soon?
lines.zh: : 说到高雅成熟，我听说你们那儿很快要搞跳蛋促销？

lines.en: : Makoto. Care to weigh in?
lines.zh: : Makoto。你要说点什么吗？

lines.en: : I...well...even {i}if{/i} that’s true, the second floor is still-
lines.zh: : 我……呃……就算{i}是{/i}真的，二楼也还是——

lines.en: : Nah, fuck that. I want details on this apparent rotor sale.
lines.zh: : 不，管他呢。我要听这场跳蛋促销的细节。

lines.en: $ dormwarssixfloor2win = True
if dormwarssixfloor1points == dormwarssixfloor2points:

: The winner of this year’s Dorm Wars is me because y’all bitches tied! And also, congrats for not having any weird and secret contests that would have tipped the scales this time! I’ll be accepting my slave now!
lines.zh: : 今年宿舍战争的获胜者是我，因为你们这帮小婊子打平了！另外恭喜大家，这次没有搞什么会左右胜负的古怪秘密比赛！现在我要来领我的奴隶了！

lines.en: scene endofwarsix11
: {i}Hah...{/i}if only everyone was willing to go as far as I did in order to secure a victory.
lines.zh: {i}哈……{/i}要是每个人都愿意像我这样为了拿下胜利而不择手段就好了。

lines.en: : You mean bribery?
lines.zh: : 你是说贿赂？

lines.en: : Yes. So?
lines.zh: : 对。怎么了？

lines.en: : I’m obviously sad, but I guess this kind of {i}is{/i} the best option for everybody when you really think about it.
lines.zh: : 我当然很难过，不过仔细想想，这对大家来说{i}确实{/i}是最好的结果。

lines.en: : It...It is? How?
lines.zh: : 是……是吗？怎么说？

lines.en: : Just cause, like...the Dorm Wars is all about us, but you play just as big of a role as we do and never really get anything out of it.
lines.zh: : 就是……你看，宿舍战争是围绕我们转的，可你扮演的角色跟我们一样重要，却从来没真正从中得到过什么。

lines.en: : Giving you a shot to win, even if it’s an unlikely one, grants you the same opportunity {i}we{/i} have to spend more time with the person you like.
lines.zh: : 给你一个赢的机会——哪怕希望渺茫——也就给了你跟{i}我们{/i}一样的机会，能多跟喜欢的人待在一起。

lines.en: : That’s...really sweet, Uta. But responding would be akin to admitting that I have feelings for a coworker and fraternization between employees is a reportable offense that-
lines.zh: : 这……真贴心，Uta。可我要是回应，就等于承认我对同事有感情，而员工之间关系过密是要被举报的行为，那样——

lines.en: : None of us care, Imani.
lines.zh: : 我们没人在乎，Imani。

lines.en: : I love him so much. Please do not weaponize your collective youth and cuteness to take him from me.
lines.zh: : 我太爱他了。求你们别把集体的青春和可爱当成武器，把他从我身边抢走。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix12
: Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了。

lines.en: : Did you get that?
lines.zh: : 录到了吗？

lines.en: : Get what? What is that?
lines.zh: : 录到什么？那是什么？

lines.en: : They call them cell phones nowadays. I’m not sure if they were called something different when you were our age.
lines.zh: : 这年头管它叫手机。不知道你们那会儿是不是叫别的名字。

lines.en: : Just gotta send this to the principal and-
lines.zh: : 只要把这个发给校长，然后——

lines.en: scene endofwarsix13
: Wait, you’re {i}blackmailing{/i} me?! What the hell, guys?! What happened to all that stuff about giving me a chance to win and...and the role I play in the Dorm Wars?!
lines.zh: : 等等，你们在{i}勒索{/i}我？！搞什么鬼啊？！那些「给我一个赢的机会」、还有「我在宿舍战争里的角色」的话都哪去了？！

lines.en: : It’s like that old phrase goes Imani — all is fair in dorm and wars.
lines.zh: : 老话怎么说的来着，Imani——宿舍与战争之中，一切手段皆公平。

lines.en: : That’s not the phrase at all!
lines.zh: : 根本就没有这句老话！

lines.en: : There’s a chance we’d be willing to {i}destroy{/i} that recording, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，我们也有可能愿意{i}销毁{/i}那段录音。

lines.en: : And all we ask in exchange is that you let Makocchi and me in on your victory.
lines.zh: : 而我们唯一的要求，是你让我们和 Makocchi 也分一杯你的胜利之羹。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix14
: You...You want me to {i}share{/i} Senpai with you guys? What would that even entail?
lines.zh: : 你……你们想让我跟你们{i}分享{/i} Senpai？那到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : We’re not sure. You tell us.
lines.zh: : 我们也不确定。你告诉我们。

lines.en: : Yeah. You weren’t planning on doing anything {i}inappropriate{/i} with him during your alone time. Were you, Imani?
lines.zh: : 是啊。你独处的那段时间里，总不打算对他做什么{i}不合适{/i}的事吧。对吧，Imani？

lines.en: : Uhh...n...noooooo...the thought never even...never even crossed my mind.
lines.zh: : 呃……没……没有ooo……我从来没……从来没想过。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’d have no trouble allowing us to join then, would you?
lines.zh: : 那你让我们加入肯定也没问题咯？

lines.en: : Especially when the alternative is seeing that the principal gets a copy of-
lines.zh: : 尤其是，另一种选择是让校长也收到一份——

lines.en: scene endofwarsix15
: Damn it, fine! Just delete the damn recording!
lines.zh: : 该死，行吧！把那该死的录音删了！

lines.en: $ dormwarssiximaniwin = True
scene endofwarsix16
: Tsuneyo, how’d your contest last night go? I had to bail early to go watch my sister, but I heard you were great.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你昨晚的比赛怎么样？我得提前撤去看我姐，不过听说你表现很棒。

lines.en: : You know I was in that too, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我也参加了，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, obvs. I was told not to ask about yours, though.
lines.zh: : 知道，当然。不过有人叫我不许问你的。

lines.en: : I was exceptional. Everyone loves me now. The Emerald Guardian has never been so impressed with my knowledge of fairies before.
lines.zh: : 我表现得极其出色。现在人人都爱我了。翡翠守护者从未对我的妖精知识这么刮目相看过。

lines.en: : If only you were as good at cooking as I am at acting. Maybe then we would be able to carry on this conversation for longer?
lines.zh: : 要是你做饭有我演戏那么厉害就好了。也许那样我们这段对话还能多聊会儿？

lines.en: scene endofwarsix17
: I’m normally better. Just caught in a bit of an emotional vortex now that culminated in me sort of blowing up in front of my role model the other night.
lines.zh: : 我平时更好。只是现在陷进了一点情绪漩涡，最终演变成前几天晚上我在偶像面前情绪爆发。

lines.en: : Yeah, bunch of us were takin’ bets on whether or not you and the pink lady were both gonna make it out of the hotel alive.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我们好几个在打赌，看你和那位粉发小姐能不能都活着走出酒店。

lines.en: : Lost a thousand yen thanks to you, Chika. You were supposed to walk outta there with her head on a pike.
lines.zh: : 因为你，我输了一千日元，Chika。你本来该把她的头插在长矛上走出来的。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix18

: I’m not a murderer, Miku. And if I was, there are a million people I’d kill before {i}Niki.{/i} All {i}she{/i} did was try to reason with someone clearly going insane {i}and{/i} fucking her boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 我不是杀人犯，Miku。就算我是，我也有整整一百万人要杀，{i}Niki{/i}还排不上号。{i}她{/i}做的不过是试着跟一个明显已经疯掉的人讲道理，{i}外加{/i}睡了她男朋友。

lines.en: : You seem a lot better now, at least. I know ya had Rin worried sick the last couple days. Girl was lookin’ after you like she was some kinda babysitter.
lines.zh: : 至少你现在看起来好多了。我知道你让 Rin 担心坏了，这两天她照顾你照顾得像个保姆似的。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix19
: Is...Is that so?...
lines.zh: : 是……是这样吗？……

lines.en: : She’s standing near a floating caption if you would like to speak to her. And quite an ominous one, at that.
lines.zh: : 她正站在一个悬浮字幕旁边，如果你想跟她说话的话。而且那字幕看起来还挺不祥的。

lines.en: : Um...yeah. Yeah, I’ll...
lines.zh: : 呃……好。好，我去……

lines.en: : Maybe I should do that...
lines.zh: : 也许我该去一下……

lines.en: : So you’re good then? You ain’t gonna do any of that crazy stuff anymore?
lines.zh: : 那你没事了？不会再干那些疯事了？

lines.en: : I’ve got one of those therapist things now if you’re lookin’ to-
lines.zh: : 我这儿有个心理医生之类的资源，要是你想——

lines.en: : I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: scene black
: I think I...got the wake up call I needed this weekend...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我……这个周末得到了我需要的那个警钟……

lines.en: scene endofwarsix20
: Well, damn. If it ain’t my new little sister. What are you doing all the way over here? Shouldn’t you be holed up in a castle somewhere or something?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，瞧瞧，这不是我的新妹妹吗。你跑这么远来干什么？你不是该窝在哪个城堡里吗？

lines.en: : Oh. Hi, Otoha. I’m tagging along with my real sister today to try out archery and learn about vending machines.
lines.zh: : 哦。你好，Otoha。我今天跟着我亲姐姐来试试射箭，顺便了解一下自动贩卖机。

lines.en: : I’d invite you, but the gap in our respective social classes prohibits me from doing so without the risk of being disowned by my family. Only Onee-sama is allowed to play with commoners.
lines.zh: : 我想邀请你来着，但我们之间的阶级差距让我没法这么做，否则有被家族除名的风险。只有姐姐大人被允许和平民玩耍。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix21
: We do not {i}play{/i} with commoners, Tsukasa. We treat them as our peers, for the only thing that differentiates us is the amount of money we carry with-
lines.zh: : 我们不是跟平民{i}玩耍{/i}，Tsukasa。我们把他们当同辈看待，因为唯一的区别就是我们身上带多少钱——

lines.en: : But didn’t you tell Mother the other night that the only reason you couldn’t answer your phone was because you were out playing with Jeeves?
lines.zh: : 可你前几天晚上不是跟母亲说，你没接电话的唯一原因是你出去跟 Jeeves 玩了？

lines.en: scene endofwarsix22
: T...Those were absolutely not {i}my{/i} words! And if you heard it from her, chances are she only said that to get you to...s...stop asking questions!
lines.zh: : 那……那绝对不是{i}我{/i}的原话！你要是从她那儿听来的，她多半只是为了让你……别……别再问了！

lines.en: : There’s no need to be embarrassed, Onee-sama. I’ve heard Jeeves “play” all sorts of games with Chinami’s sister. You’re a growing girl. It only makes sense that you’d want to “play” with him too.
lines.zh: : 姐姐大人不必害羞。我听说 Jeeves 跟 Chinami 的姐姐「玩」过各种各样的游戏。你正是长大的年纪，想跟他「玩」也很正常。

lines.en: : Stop saying “play” like that! At least reach high school before you start...dropping innuendos all over the place!
lines.zh: : 别那样说「玩」！至少等你上了高中再……到处甩暧昧暗示！

lines.en: scene endofwarsix23
: I’m just a little girl. What’s an “innuendo?” I’ve never heard that word before.
lines.zh: : 我只是个小女孩。「暧昧暗示」是什么？我从没听过这个词。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, you little...{i}demon!{/i} You know exactly what you’re implying!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，你这个小……{i}恶魔{/i}！你明明知道自己在暗示什么！

lines.en: : Listen, Onee-sama, all I’m saying is that you {i}need{/i} to answer the phone when Mother calls. For all you know, it could have been an emergency. I could have been trapped in a well.
lines.zh: : 听着，姐姐大人，我要说的只是母亲打电话时你{i}必须{/i}接。说不定那是紧急情况呢。说不定我被困在井里了。

lines.en: : I often wish you were...
lines.zh: : 我常常希望你真的……

lines.en: : Interesting dynamic the two of you have.
lines.zh: : 你们俩的关系真有意思。

lines.en: : You’d understand completely if you were her sister for more than thirty minutes.
lines.zh: : 你要是当她姐姐超过三十分钟，就完全明白了。

lines.en: : At least Otoha calls me smart. I can’t remember the last time you said anything kind about me at all, Onee-sama.
lines.zh: : 至少 Otoha 会说我聪明。我都记不清你上次说我的好话是什么时候了，姐姐大人。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix24
: I can’t remember the last time you gave me a {i}reason{/i} to...
lines.zh: : 我也记不清你上次给我{i}理由{/i}是什么时候了……

lines.en: : You want to go get ice cream or something, Tsukasa? My treat.
lines.zh: : 想去吃个冰淇淋什么的吗，Tsukasa？我请客。

lines.en: : Why? I have infinitely more money than you. I could buy a whole ice cream {i}factory{/i} right now if I wanted to.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我的钱比你多得多。只要我想，我现在就能买下一整座冰淇淋{i}工厂{/i}。

lines.en: : Want to go look for one then?
lines.zh: : 那要去找找看吗？

lines.en: : You’ll...go look for investment opportunities with me?
lines.zh: : 你……愿意陪我去看投资机会？

lines.en: : Or we could just...you know...hang out. Unless you wanted to go try out archery, I mean.
lines.zh: : 或者我们也可以就……你知道的……随便逛逛。除非你想去试试射箭，我是说。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix25
: Can I, Onee-sama?
lines.zh: : 我可以吗，姐姐大人？

lines.en: : Am I...to {i}pay{/i} you for this, Otoha? What are you charging, exactly?
lines.zh: : 我……该为这个{i}付钱{/i}给你吗，Otoha？你具体收费多少？

lines.en: : Nothing. I just don’t really have anything going on and it seems to me that the two of you aren’t really feeling each other’s company at the moment.
lines.zh: : 不用。我只是没什么事做，而且在我看来，你俩现在都不太想跟对方待在一起。

lines.en: : You don’t intend to hold her hostage, do you? Because she would still fetch a good sum despite not being the true heir of our family.
lines.zh: : 你该不会想绑架她吧？因为就算她不是我们家真正的继承人，她也还能卖个好价钱。

lines.en: : I wasn’t planning on it but, when you put it that way, maybe I should?
lines.zh: : 我本来没这打算，不过被你这么一说，也许我该考虑一下？

lines.en: scene endofwarsix26
: Can you ransom me {i}after{/i} we get ice cream? All I had for breakfast was oatmeal. I don’t understand why anyone eats it, honestly.
lines.zh: : 你能{i}等{/i}我们吃完冰淇淋再勒索我吗？我早餐只吃了燕麦粥。说实话我真不懂为什么会有人吃那玩意儿。

lines.en: : Sure, kid. I’ll ransom you after we get ice cream.
lines.zh: : 行啊，小鬼。吃完冰淇淋我再勒索你。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix27
: {i}Okay! See you at home, Onee-sama! Please don’t tell Mother I’m hanging out with strangers!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}好耶！姐姐大人，家里见！千万别告诉母亲我跟陌生人出去玩了！{/i}

lines.en: : Oh...sure.
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Why does this make me feel sad?
lines.zh: : 为什么这事让我觉得难过？

lines.en: scene endofwarsix28
: You haven’t gotten a hold of her since last night? Really?
lines.zh: : 从昨晚到现在你都联系不上她？真的？

lines.en: : I’m not worried or anything. She barely ever answers my texts to begin with. It’s just weird that she showed up for, like...two minutes and then immediately disappeared.
lines.zh: : 我也没担心什么的。她本来就不怎么回我短信。只是她露了个面就……大概两分钟吧，然后马上又消失了，挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : And with Maya no less.
lines.zh: : 而且还是跟 Maya 一起。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix29

: {i}That’s{/i} just coincidental, I’m sure. If Maya won’t even talk to {i}me,{/i} the chances of her holding a conversation with Nee-chan are less than zero. I doubt she could even be {i}forced{/i} to, honestly.
lines.zh: {i}那{/i}肯定是巧合。如果 Maya 连{i}我{/i}都不肯说话，她跟老姐聊起来的可能性就小于零。说实话，我怀疑就算{i}逼{/i}她都做不到。

lines.en: : Imagine they became best friends behind your back and Maya just kept avoiding you despite your undying need to try and win her over?
lines.zh: : 想象一下：她俩背着你成了最好的朋友，而 Maya 一直躲着你，尽管你有着不死不休的、想赢回她的执念？

lines.en: scene endofwarsix30
: Imagine I cut your head off and kept it in a box beneath my bed?
lines.zh: : 想象一下：我把你的头砍下来，装在床底下的盒子里？

lines.en: : Hey, I’m just saying — Niki’s clearly the frontrunner out of {i}everybody{/i} when you factor in her status and connection to Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我只是说——把她的地位和她跟 Sensei 的关系算进去，Niki 显然是{i}所有人{/i}里领跑的那个。

lines.en: : If I’m Maya, I’m probably thinking that cozying up to her might win me some points.
lines.zh: : 如果我是 Maya，我大概会想，跟她套近乎说不定能给自己加分。

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} Maya, though. We’re {i}all{/i} Maya. But you don’t see every one of {i}us{/i} trying to become friends with my sister because it makes our pursuit of love feel less authentic.
lines.zh: : 可你{i}就是{/i} Maya 啊。我们{i}全都{/i}是 Maya。但你没看见{i}我们{/i}每个人都跑去跟我姐交朋友——因为那会让我们追求爱情这件事显得不那么真诚。

lines.en: : Easy for you to say. She already saw you riding her boyfriend like there was no tomorrow. {i}Plus,{/i} you go back over a decade. None of us are able to compete with that at all.
lines.zh: : 你说得轻巧。她早就看过你骑在她男朋友身上、仿佛没有明天。{i}再说了{/i}，你跟他是十几年交情。我们谁都比不了。

lines.en: : I don’t know how I’m somehow {i}gaining{/i} points for getting caught by my sister in your book, but I’m pretty sure it doesn’t work that way.
lines.zh: : 我不明白在你那套算法里，我怎么还能因为被姐姐抓包而{i}加{/i}分，但我敢肯定事情不是这么运作的。

lines.en: : I had a threesome with Akira and the ghost of Ami’s mother once.
lines.zh: : 我曾经跟 Akira 和 Ami 妈妈的鬼魂搞过一次三人行。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix31
: Come again?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Right now? I can try. There’s a chance I get stage fright, though. I’ve never masturbated in front of this many people before.
lines.zh: : 现在来？我可以试试。不过我可能会怯场。我还没在这么多人面前自慰过。

lines.en: : Just...for my own records, how does one have a threesome with a ghost exactly?
lines.zh: : 只是……我自己想记一下，一个人到底要怎么跟鬼魂搞三人行？

lines.en: : It was the strangest thing...but I could feel her there. And Akira, he could {i}see{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 那是最奇怪的事……可我能感觉到她在那儿。而 Akira，他能{i}看见{/i}她。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix32
: Which makes me curious about threesomes with other dead people. And whether or not Yasu’s theory on death has any merit to it.
lines.zh: : 这让我好奇起跟别的死人搞三人行。也好奇 Yasu 那套关于死亡的理论有没有道理。

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s true that our existence is not just planar, but tangibly so. Stranger things have been found to be true. And what comes after death is one of the most hotly contested questions out there.
lines.zh: : 也许我们的存在不只是平面性的，而是有形可触的，这话不假。更奇怪的事都被证实过。而死后的世界，是世上争议最多的问题之一。

lines.en: : If only I could have spoken to her without a medium...
lines.zh: : 要是我能不通过灵媒就跟她说上话就好了……

lines.en: scene endofwarsix33
: Do you think that we’ll follow suit if death ever finds {i}us{/i} amidst the sea of permanence? And will the waves of our passing cascade and crash upon the shores of those who come after?
lines.zh: : 你觉得，如果死亡在那片永恒之海中找到{i}我们{/i}，我们也会步其后尘吗？我们逝去的浪涛，会层层叠叠地拍打在后人的岸上吗？

lines.en: : I...am an atheist. So no.
lines.zh: : 我……是无神论者。所以不会。

lines.en: : I suppose I am too. But that doesn’t mean I’m not still curious. Believing in science is the most fluid system of all when we’re learning new things every day.
lines.zh: : 我想我也是。可这不代表我不好奇。在我们每天都在学新东西的情况下，相信科学反而是最灵活的一套体系。

lines.en: : Right. Well...maybe you can write a thesis statement on ghostly threesomes when you get to college.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那个……等你上了大学，也许可以写一篇关于人鬼三人行的论文开题。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix34
: That’s actually not a bad idea. I don’t think anyone’s ever written one on that before.
lines.zh: : 这主意其实不赖。我觉得以前没人写过这个题目。

lines.en: : I’d likely have to omit my personal experiences on the subject, though. I imagine I’d likely just be called crazy if I were to include those.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概得略去自己在这方面的亲身经历。要是写进去，我想我多半会被当成疯子。

lines.en: : Well, I definitely can’t imagine why.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我完全想不出为什么。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix35
: Welp, I guess that’s that then. Another year, another war. But will these battles rage on forever, I wonder? And is there any hope for us at all amidst the expansive turmoil we call our lives?
lines.zh: : 唉，那大概就是这样了。又一年，又一场战争。可我不禁想，这些战斗会永远持续下去吗？在我们称之为人生的一片广阔混乱里，我们到底还有没有希望？

lines.en: : You’re reading existential manga again, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你又在看存在主义漫画了吧？

lines.en: scene endofwarsix36
: It’s so good. And it’s made me feel like a main character all weekend long.
lines.zh: : 太好看了。而且它让我整个周末都觉得自己像个主角。

lines.en: : It does seem as if line distribution has been heavily tilted in your favor the last few days, yes.
lines.zh: : 确实，这几天台词分配好像严重向你倾斜了。

lines.en: : You don’t think I’m about to get my first h-scene, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会觉得我马上要有第一场 H 场景了吧？

lines.en: : Do all of the ones with Otoha not count?
lines.zh: : 跟 Otoha 的那些都不算吗？

lines.en: : Not commercially. There’s a reason yuri’s the worst selling genre on the market. Chances are I might not even get renewed if I don’t have sex with a real penis soon.
lines.zh: : 从商业角度不算。百合之所以是市场上卖得最差的类型是有原因的。再不跟真家伙做一次，我说不定连续订都拿不到。

lines.en: : Ignoring whatever fantasy world the two of them are in...how are you doing, Ami? You’ve seemed a little happier than normal lately.
lines.zh: : 先不管她俩活在什么幻想世界里……Ami，你最近怎么样？你看起来比平时开心一点。

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} happier than normal! I’ve got the perfect dad, I live in the perfect town, and I go to a perfect school with all of my perfect friends. Who has it better than me?
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}比平时开心！我有完美的爸爸，住在完美的小镇，还在一所完美的学校里跟我所有完美的朋友们一起上学。谁比我过得更好？

lines.en: scene endofwarsix37
: I wish I could be that optimistic.
lines.zh: : 我真希望能像你这么乐观。

lines.en: : It feels to me like this season’s dragging on forever sometimes. It makes it hard to keep track of whether or not I’m actually going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 有时候我觉得这一季拖得没完没了。害我都搞不清自己到底有没有在往前走。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix38
: Oh, right?! I was just thinking about that the other day! Nothing ever changes anymore! It’s, like...day in, day out. Go to sleep. Wake up. Go to school. Go home.
lines.zh: : 哦，对吧？！我前几天还在想这个！现在什么都没变化了！就是……日复一日。睡觉。起床。上学。回家。

lines.en: : Like it’s all part of some never ending cycle! I thought the days of our youth were supposed to go by the fastest of all? That’s what my mom says whenever I remind her of how old she is, at least.
lines.zh: : 就好像全都是某个永无止境的循环的一部分！我还以为青春的日子应该过得最快呢？至少每次我提醒我妈她多大了的时候，她都这么说。

lines.en: : It’s a timeloop, I tell you. And the only way out is for the main character to complete all of the routes.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说，这是时间循环。唯一的出路就是让主角把所有路线都通关。

lines.en: scene endofwarsix39
: That’s good for Ami, I guess...
lines.zh: : 那对 Ami 倒是好事，我猜……

lines.en: : Heheh...being the daughter of the protagonist comes with its perks for sure.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……当主角的女儿确实有好处。

lines.en: : Unless you were an optional heroine. And Sensei deciding not to pork you just bricked the entire save file or something.
lines.zh: : 除非你是个可选女主角。而 Sensei 决定不睡你，就把整个存档给搞坏了什么的。

lines.en: : As if something like that would ever happen!
lines.zh: : 好像真会发生那种事似的！

lines.en: scene sky
: This world is too full of good things for there to be something sad like that.
lines.zh: : 这个世界上的好事太多了，不会有什么那么悲伤的事。

lines.en: : So if, for some reason, a bad ending like that {i}does{/i} exist, I’m sure it’ll just be a temporary one! Maybe even a prequel! And you can start the game all over to get to what’s {i}really{/i} important.
lines.zh: : 所以万一真的存在那样的坏结局，我敢肯定那也只是暂时的！说不定还是个前传！你可以重开游戏，去追求{i}真正{/i}重要的东西。

lines.en: : Incest?
lines.zh: : 乱伦？

lines.en: : {i}Exactly.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}正是。{/i}

lines.en: : Hah...well, at least you’re passionate about something.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧，至少你对某件事很有热情。

lines.en: : Just don’t let your passion manifest like Molly’s where it ultimately consumes you and there’s just nothing left at all.
lines.zh: : 只是别让你的热情像 Molly 那样走火入魔，最终把你整个人吞噬掉，什么都没剩下。

lines.en: : Honestly, I feel like Ami’s even further down that path than I am.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得 Ami 在这条路上走得比我还远。

lines.en: : Yeah, you actually might be right now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你这么一说，你可能还真说对了。

lines.en: : Where {i}is{/i} Sensei, by the way? He normally shows up to these, doesn’t he?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，Sensei {i}到底在哪儿{/i}？这种场合他平时都会来的吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know, actually. He never came home last night. I’m sure he’s fine, though!
lines.zh: : 说实话我不知道。他昨晚没回家。不过我肯定他没事！

lines.en: : Really? You aren’t going to curse him? I know a summoning spell that might-
lines.zh: : 真的？你不诅咒他一下？我知道一个召唤咒，说不定能——

lines.en: : It’s fine, Molly. Really.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Molly。真的。

lines.en: : Wherever he is, I know he’s thinking the same thing as me right now.
lines.zh: : 无论他在哪儿，我知道他现在跟我想的是同一件事。

lines.en: : We’re sort of just...{i}connected{/i} like that.
lines.zh: : 我们就是……这样{i}心意相通{/i}。

lines.en: : And if things were to ever just stop one day, I’m sure he and I would be the first to know.
lines.zh: : 如果哪天一切突然停下，我敢肯定他和我都会最先知道。

lines.en: : But until then, I guess there’s not much we can do but just...wait for him to do what you were saying earlier.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，我想我们也没什么能做的，只能……等他去做你刚才说的那件事。

lines.en: : Which part? The one about completing all of our routes?
lines.zh: : 哪部分？把所有路线都通关那部分？

lines.en: : Are we really back on this?
lines.zh: : 我们真的又绕回这个话题了？

lines.en: : That {i}is{/i} how these melancholic harems normally end, right? Where we all sort of fade out of the main menu screen once our stories have come to a close?
lines.zh: : 这种忧郁后宫向的作品{i}就是{/i}这么收尾的吧？等我们的故事讲完，大家就都从主菜单界面上渐渐淡出？

lines.en: : Aye, but I imagine ours is a little different.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过我觉得我们这个有点不一样。

lines.en: : Different how? I don’t normally play those types of games.
lines.zh: : 怎么不一样？我平时不怎么玩那类游戏。

lines.en: : Well, the days we’re experiencing now don’t quite feel like {i}routes{/i} at all, do they? It’s like we’re all just part of a never-ending common route where we all gain ground little by little.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们现在经历的这些日子，感觉一点也不像{i}路线{/i}，对吧？就好像我们都只是某条永无止境的共通路线的一部分，大家一起一点一点地推进。

lines.en: : It would have to be the longest common route of all time with how things have felt lately.
lines.zh: : 以最近的感觉来看，那得是有史以来最长的共通路线了。

lines.en: : In a sense, I’m sure it is. But life itself is long too, is it not? Or at least it’s {i}supposed{/i} to be.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上，我想确实是。可人生本身也很长，不是吗？至少它{i}本该{/i}是长的。

lines.en: : That’s probably true most of the time, yeah.
lines.zh: : 大多数时候大概是这样吧。

lines.en: : That still doesn’t stop things from just suddenly ending sometimes, though.
lines.zh: : 可那也挡不住有些事情就是会突然结束。

scene bedroom_noon
: What should I do now?
lines.zh: : 我现在该怎么办？
